meta.name: formax-web-css-convergence-workflow
meta.description: Use when changing web CSS/UI styling so requirements, state ownership, and acceptance checks are locked before edits to prevent rework churn.

copy.tagline: 锁定UI需求后再改样式，减少返工
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常改CSS但需求不清导致反复重做
copy.tagline_en: Lock UI requirements before editing CSS to reduce rework
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often redo CSS due to unclear requirements

howto.what: 当你提出网页样式修改需求时，Claude会先要求你填写8项输入合同（包括目标模型、不触碰清单、验收标准等），确认后才开始编辑。每次仅修改一个方面（如先改布局，再改颜色），避免混乱返工。
howto.when: 当你要求调整组件样式、布局、交互视觉状态（如hover/active/focus），或涉及跨文件CSS/TSX类修改，以及反复UI调优时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个按钮的hover颜色改成蓝色
say.note: Claude会先让你确认目标模型和验收标准再修改。

say.text: 调整左侧导航栏的布局，间距加大
say.note: Claude会锁定不触碰区域，只改布局。

say.text: 这个面板的选中状态边框样式需要改一下
say.note: Claude会分步按单轴模式修改。

howto.what_en: When you request web CSS/UI changes, Claude first asks you to fill an 8-line intake contract (target model, non-goals, acceptance criteria, etc.) before editing. It then modifies only one axis per pass (e.g., layout first, then colors) to prevent rework.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to adjust component styling, layout, interactive visual states (hover/active/focus), or cross-file CSS/TSX changes, and during repeated UI tuning.

say_en.text: Change this button's hover color to blue.
say_en.note: Claude will ask you to confirm the target model and acceptance criteria first.

say_en.text: Increase spacing in the left navigation bar layout.
say_en.note: Claude locks untouched areas and only modifies layout.

say_en.text: Modify the selected state border style of this panel.
say_en.note: Claude proceeds step-by-step with single-axis convergence.
